figurative_meaning_en: sickly and emaciated; skinny and bony
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুর্ভিক্ষের পর গ্রামের অনেকেই ঘিয়ে ভাজা হয়ে গিয়েছে।
সেই বৃদ্ধ লোকটি দেখতে ঘিয়ে ভাজা কুকুরের মতো হাড়-জিরজিরে।
example_sentences_in_english: After the famine, many villagers became as emaciated as if fried in ghee.
The old man looked skinny and bony, like a dog fried in ghee.
history: This idiom originates from the vivid imagery of a stray dog so thin and frail that it appears as if it has been fried in ghee, symbolizing extreme malnutrition often seen in rural Bengali contexts during times of scarcity.
note: The idiom evokes a sense of pity and hardship, commonly used in literature to describe poverty-stricken conditions.
